name: Chicken Cafreal
instructions: 1. Blend coriander leaves, green chilies, ginger-garlic paste, cinnamon, cloves, cumin, peppercorns, poppy seeds, and turmeric with lime juice into a smooth green paste.
2. Marinate the chicken pieces in this green paste along with salt for at least 2 to 4 hours, preferably overnight.
3. Heat oil or ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan or skillet.
4. Place the chicken pieces in the pan and sear them on medium-high heat until browned.
5. Reduce the heat, cover, and cook until the chicken is tender and the marinade has formed a thick, aromatic coating.
6. Serve hot, garnished with lime wedges and onion rings.
description: Chicken Cafreal is a spicy, herbaceous dish with roots in the African colonies of the Portuguese Empire, brought to Goa by African soldiers serving in the Portuguese army. It is a hallmark of Goan-Catholic cuisine, celebrated for its brilliant green color and bold, complex flavor profile.
